name: texas-trip-planner
description: AI trip planner for camping and hiking in Texas, with an automated test suite that scores every plan.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
